Final-head integration/evidence review at a539ea1e12e98f449264a5a28bad64a3bb8b6416:

The genuine media remains labeled with captured SHA ad0c9ce9847dbad62fe0d636134250310cf5c95b; it has not been relabeled as a newer capture. Git blob/tree equality was verified for train runtime, the entire train test directory (including visual fixture/runner), civ13.dme, atom and movable atom paths, structures, mob movement/new-player code, observation callbacks, turfs, startup globals/world, defines, and complete icons/sound/interface/UI/maps/config trees.

The merged wire integration changes /obj/Destroy by adding cleanup only under if(powersource). The unchanged object defaults are powerneeded=0 and powersource=null. Train types and this fixture never assign/connect powersource, so that new branch is inactive for the captured train actors; existing nonpower destruction fallthrough is unchanged. Other changed electrical modules are outside the captured actions. This is scoped train-evidence equivalence, not a claim that all merged game code is identical or that electrical gameplay was tested here.

Fresh final-head actual-game probe: 19 assertions pass on Windows BYOND516.1681, NOMADS155x225x2; compile zero errors/warnings. The read-only workflow permissions finding is marked fixed by CodeQL. Both AGENTS verification notes and all upstream workflow steps were preserved. Copilot could not review due requester quota; CodeRabbit review is pending. Public PNG/video attachment bytes matched local SHA256 via unauthenticated HTTP200 GET; generated local media was then deleted. The sampled native video decoded successfully. The capture world was later terminated by its runner resource guard during a final refresh, after both demos stopped and emitted health995/automovement0; startup bad-reference diagnostics remain disclosed. No production crash reproduction, deployment or restart was performed.
